name: modify_add_type_hints
description: Adds type hints to an existing Python file
prompts: Add type hints to all function parameters and return types in utils.py. Do not change any function's behavior or signature order.

test_setup_files.test_utils.py:
import importlib.util, inspect
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('utils_mod', 'utils.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert mod.add(2, 3) == 5, f'add(2, 3) = {mod.add(2, 3)}, expected 5'
assert mod.greet('World') == 'Hello, World', f"greet('World') = {mod.greet('World')!r}"
assert mod.clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10, f'clamp(15, 0, 10) = {mod.clamp(15, 0, 10)}, expected 10'
assert mod.clamp(-5, 0, 10) == 0, f'clamp(-5, 0, 10) = {mod.clamp(-5, 0, 10)}, expected 0'
for fname in ('add', 'greet', 'clamp'):
    sig = inspect.signature(getattr(mod, fname))
    assert sig.return_annotation is not inspect.Signature.empty, f'{fname}() missing a return type hint'
    for pname, param in sig.parameters.items():
        assert param.annotation is not inspect.Signature.empty, f'{fname}() parameter {pname!r} missing a type hint'
print('PASS')
